note: Consumed CockroachDB Agent Skills, pinned by upstream commit. The commit was read from https://api.github.com/repos/cockroachlabs/cockroachdb-skills/commits on 2026-08-04 and is the repository HEAD of 2026-07-22. `expected_sha256` is null on every entry because the build machine had the commit and not the bytes; see mainline_steward/skills.py for why a digest we had not computed was not written here, and run `mainline-steward skills record` against a real checkout to fill them in. Nine skills across the three POPULATED domains (ARCHITECTURE.md §9.4); the four empty domains are consumed by nobody and filed into by `skills-published`.

skills.why: Nightly. Its native diagnostics read crdb_internal, which the Managed MCP surface cannot reach; it is pointed at mainline_audit.v_gate_latency_daily and v_txn_restart_daily instead.
Nightly. Same substitution: statement-level detail is unreachable over MCP, so the run reads the pre-materialised daily latency view and says so.
Nightly. Changefeeds are jobs, and a stalled custody feed is the failure that looks exactly like nothing happening; mainline_audit.v_changefeed_health is the job surface here.
Weekly. Reads mainline_audit.v_agent_actions: which agent role used which tool, with what outcome. The grant matrix itself is in GRANTS.yaml and is asserted by the kernel suite, not by a model.
Weekly. Pairs with the custodian patrol's `ccloud audit list`: the cloud audit log is the one record a cluster admin does not author.
Weekly. The only skill whose native surface is the Cloud API rather than SQL, so it is the one the ccloud shim serves directly.
Weekly. Reads mainline_audit.v_ledger_health and v_open_gate_summary — in this product cluster health that ignores open witness debt is not health.
Weekly. SHOW CLUSTER SETTING is reachable over MCP via show_statement; the Steward may read a setting and may never change one.
Weekly. Reads mainline_audit.v_unused_indexes; index churn on a vector-indexed table is fenced by the circuit breaker, so the finding is advisory and is marked as such.
